tasks.short: Interpret specifications, blueprints and procedures for workers

steps.what: Open the live job order on the operations screen
Read specifications, blueprints, policies and procedures

loop.purpose: quote the procedure sentence the job order already names
loop.input: drawing id, procedure paragraph id, and the stored paragraph text
loop.output: a card with the order quantity and that quoted sentence only
loop.check: every sentence on the card is a verbatim quote of that paragraph, and the card adds no instruction the paragraph does not contain
loop.stop: missing paragraph id, or a sentence that is not in the paragraph; he then reads the binder
loop.why_not_simpler: a link to the file does not show whether that sentence is the one for this order line

steps.what: Judge which procedure applies when the blueprint conflicts
Explain those specifications to the workers on the job
Mail the planner when the blueprint is missing
Note a quantity change on the job sheet

tasks.design: When a job order in {OPS_SYSTEM} already names a drawing and a procedure paragraph in {DOCS}, a card quotes that sentence beside the order line and adds nothing the paragraph does not say. The production supervisor still judges a conflict and still explains it to the workers. If the order has no paragraph id, he reads the binder and this saving does not apply.
tasks.previous_blocker: The procedure sat in a binder the job order did not name, so each job started with a hunt.
tasks.enabler_now: The procedure can be a stored paragraph, and a short loop can check that a card only quotes it.
tasks.still_hard: He must still decide when the blueprint and the procedure disagree, and say it on a noisy line.
tasks.human_edge: He hears what the worker did not follow and decides which rule wins when the drawing and the procedure disagree.

ambition.what: Which procedure sentence this job order actually names, before he walks over to explain it.

tasks.altitude: The morning is still on the floor explaining jobs. He still rules on a conflict. Hunting a paragraph shrinks only when the order already names it.

reach.task: File each procedure as a paragraph a job order can name
reach.learn: Which conflicts the supervisor still has to judge in person

evidence.claim: Showing a stored procedure sentence next to an order line is retrieval. The supervisor still judges a conflict and still explains it. Model knowledge.

Annex III point 4(b) is high risk when a system allocates tasks from behaviour or personal traits, or monitors and evaluates workers. This card only quotes a stored procedure sentence and does not do that.

assumptions: Focal boundary is the supervisor reading, judging and explaining this job. The planner's release and the process engineer's procedure are other roles and are not in this baseline.

Contract for the shorter read: drawing id and procedure paragraph id on the job order, plus the paragraph text. Producer of the drawing id and the quantity is the planner. Producer of the paragraph text is the process engineer. If either id is empty, he reads the binder and the saving on the read does not apply.
The quote check fails closed. A sentence that is not in the paragraph is not shown. He still explains, and that talk stays at full time.
Use the document store the plant already has before building a new library.
unknowns: Whether job orders in this plant already store a procedure paragraph id.
How often the blueprint and the procedure actually disagree.
research_questions: On a typical shift, how many job orders name a procedure paragraph, and how many name only a part number?

already_counted.description: He still opens the live order himself.
He still reads the quoted card and rejects a sentence that is not in the paragraph.
He still judges a conflict between the blueprint and the procedure.
He still explains the specification to the workers.
He still mails the planner when the blueprint is missing.
He still notes a quantity change himself.

incremental.description: When a procedure paragraph changes, he checks that the card still quotes the current sentence.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Net about 9.5 after one hour checking quotes. Only the document read shrinks, and only when the order already names a procedure paragraph. Judging the conflict and explaining it to the workers stay full. High 5 assumes most orders already name the paragraph. Low 2 assumes most orders name only a part, so he still hunts the binder.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe work and monitor gauges and dials

steps.what: Observe operators so they conform to standards
Tell an operator to correct the method
Monitor gauges, dials and other indicators
Read the machine counter on the operations screen
Copy gauge readings onto the round sheet
Mail maintenance when a gauge stays stuck
Jot the shift count on the tracking sheet

tasks.design: The production supervisor still walks the line, watches the operator, and reads dials that have no counter. Where {OPS_SYSTEM} already stores machine id, count and timestamp from the machine counter, he does not copy that count onto the round sheet and only writes the exception he saw. A missing count or a missing limit means he copies the dial as today. The screen does not score the operator, and the operator is not logged in.
tasks.previous_blocker: The count lived on the dial, so the round sheet was a second copy made by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Many machines already store a count, so a numeric compare can skip that copy without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing whether the person is working to the method, and reading a dial that has no counter.
tasks.human_edge: He sees a movement no counter records, and he decides whether to stop the job.

ambition.what: Which dial he still has to read himself because that machine stores no count.

tasks.altitude: The round is still his. He still stops a job with his own eyes and still tells the operator. He copies fewer counts when the machine already stored them.

reach.task: Repair a gauge the supervisor reports as stuck
reach.learn: Which dial the supervisor still has to read because it has no counter

evidence.claim: Evocon is production monitoring. H+H replaced paper reports and spreadsheets with it, and the story gives no number for time spent walking the line. A stored machine count can be shown without retyping it. The supervisor still watches the work.

Under the Dutch works council act, article 27, consent is required for a system that can observe attendance or performance, including line monitoring with an operator login. This design reads the machine counter and does not log the operator in. Other countries have their own rules.

Annex III point 4(b) is high risk when a system monitors and evaluates workers. Comparing a machine count with a stored limit does not evaluate the operator. He still decides whether the person conforms.

assumptions: Focal boundary is his round: watching people, reading dials, telling an operator, and writing what he saw. Machine-counter runtime is system time and is not his hours. The operator's clock-in is a different task.

Contract for the shorter copy: machine id, count and timestamp. Producer is the machine counter, not a person. Min and max limits sit on the standard. Producer of the limits is the process engineer. If the count or the limit is missing, he copies the dial and the saving on the round sheet does not apply.
Watching the operator, telling them, and reading a local dial stay at full time. The round note of what he saw is still his. No operator login.
Test the counter view the operations system already has before building a new screen.
unknowns: What share of machines on this line already store a count with a timestamp.
Whether the works council treats a machine counter as performance monitoring.
research_questions: Of the numbers he copies onto the round sheet today, how many are already on a machine counter?

already_counted.description: He still walks the line and watches whether operators conform.
He still tells an operator to correct the method.
He still reads gauges and dials that have no counter.
He still glances at the counter screen.
He still writes the exception he saw on the round sheet.
He still mails maintenance when a gauge is stuck.
He still jots the shift count himself.

incremental.description: Each week he checks one stored count against a dial he can see.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Net about 3 after one hour checking a counter against a dial. Only the copy of a count the machine already stores is shorter. Watching people, reading local dials, and telling an operator stay full. High 2 if about half the copied counts already sit on a counter. Low 1 if few machines store a count.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Sort job tickets for this production shift
Sketch which employees take which orders
Direct employees at the start of the shift
Coordinate fabricators when a machine stops
Check order status on the operations screen
Mail the next shift what is unfinished

tasks.design: He reads the released-order list already in {OPS_SYSTEM}, with order id, part, quantity, work centre and due time filled by the planner, instead of sorting paper tickets. He still sketches who does the work and still tells them. A missing work centre sends him back to the paper ticket and the saving does not apply. The list does not assign people.
tasks.previous_blocker: The day's work arrived as loose tickets, and matching them to the line took the start of the shift.
tasks.enabler_now: The operations system already holds a released order, so a configured list can replace the sort when the fields are filled.
tasks.still_hard: Moving people when a machine stops, and knowing who can run it safely.
tasks.human_edge: He knows who can take the stopped machine and he says so in the moment.

ambition.what: Which released order has no work centre and still needs the paper ticket.

tasks.altitude: He still names the crew and still moves people when a machine stops. Sorting tickets shrinks only when the release is already complete. The list does not choose the person.

reach.task: Release each order with work centre, quantity and due time filled
reach.learn: Which missing field sends the supervisor back to paper tickets

evidence.claim: A released-order list with work centre and due time can replace sorting paper tickets. Directing the crew stays with the supervisor. Model knowledge.

Annex III point 4(b) is high risk when a system allocates tasks from behaviour or personal traits. Showing the planner's released order does not allocate people, and rule-based planning on machine capacity is outside that case. He still names who does the job.

assumptions: Focal boundary is directing this crew this shift. The planner's release is another role and is not in this baseline.

Contract for the shorter sort: order id, part, quantity, work centre and due time. Producer is the planner. If work centre or due time is empty, he sorts the paper ticket and the saving on the sort does not apply.
He still sketches the crew and still tells them. That talk stays at full time. The list does not assign people.
Use the released-order view the operations system already has before building a new list.
unknowns: Whether released orders in this plant already include work centre and due time.
What share of the shift still arrives as paper tickets only.
research_questions: How many released orders on a Monday are missing a work centre?

already_counted.description: He still reviews the released list and falls back to paper when a field is empty.
He still sketches which employees take which orders.
He still directs employees at the start of the shift.
He still coordinates people when a machine stops.
He still checks order status himself.
He still writes the handoff mail to the next shift.

incremental.description: When a planner changes a release, he checks the list against the board.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Net about 5.5 after one hour reconciling a changed release. Only sorting tickets shrinks, and only when work centre and due time are already filled. Directing the crew and moving people stay full. High 3 when most orders are released in the system. Low 1 when the day still arrives as paper.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train employees or assign an experienced worker

steps.what: Choose which safety procedures this employee needs
Draft the training outline from that procedure

loop.purpose: draft an outline that only quotes the approved procedure
loop.input: the approved procedure paragraph id and its text
loop.output: outline points, each a quote of that paragraph
loop.check: every point quotes the paragraph and adds no action the paragraph does not contain
loop.stop: no approved paragraph, or a point that adds a step; he then writes the outline himself
loop.why_not_simpler: copying the whole procedure does not show which sentences this person must practise

steps.what: Conduct equipment operations training on the machine
Assign the rest to an experienced worker
Mail the experienced worker the training time
Tick the training completion on the learning record
Note the training hours on the attendance sheet

tasks.design: An outline for the session quotes an approved procedure paragraph in {DOCS} and adds no step that paragraph does not contain. He still chooses the employee, still demonstrates on the machine, and still ticks completion in {LMS}. If there is no approved paragraph, he writes the outline himself and the saving does not apply. The session is not recorded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The safe method sat in a long procedure he rewrote into an outline each time he taught it.
tasks.enabler_now: An approved paragraph can be quoted, and a check can reject any step the paragraph does not contain.
tasks.still_hard: Showing the movement on the machine, and judging who is safe to finish the coaching.
tasks.human_edge: He watches the hands on the machine and stops a wrong movement before someone is hurt.

ambition.what: Which approved safety paragraph this employee has not yet been shown.

tasks.altitude: He still demonstrates and still decides who may coach. The outline is shorter only when an approved paragraph exists. He still ticks completion himself.

reach.task: Coach the rest of the method after the supervisor's demonstration
reach.learn: Which first movement the supervisor still stays to watch

evidence.claim: An outline that only quotes an approved procedure still has to be shown on the machine. The supervisor still signs the completion. Model knowledge.

Under the Dutch works council act, article 27, consent is required for systems that can observe workers, and for rules on staff personal data. This design does not record the session. The completion tick is the record he already writes. Other countries have their own rules.
Annex III point 4(b) is high risk when a system allocates tasks from behaviour or personal traits. He still chooses the person. The outline does not assign the training.

assumptions: Focal boundary is his training time: choosing the procedure, drafting the outline, demonstrating, assigning a coach, and marking completion. The experienced operator's coaching time is another role and is not zeroed.

Contract for the shorter outline: procedure paragraph id and the paragraph text. Producer is the safety owner, often the process engineer. If there is no approved paragraph, he writes the outline and the saving on the draft does not apply.
Choosing the person, the demonstration, the assignment, the mail and the completion tick stay at full time. No camera and no recording.
The outline check fails closed. A point that adds a step is dropped.
unknowns: Whether safety procedures are already stored as paragraphs that can be quoted.
Whether completion today is a learning-system tick or a paper sheet.
research_questions: Which safety paragraphs do supervisors still rewrite by hand before a session?

already_counted.description: He still chooses which safety procedure this employee needs.
He still reviews the outline and rejects a point the paragraph does not contain.
He still conducts the demonstration on the machine.
He still assigns the rest to an experienced worker.
He still mails the experienced worker.
He still ticks completion himself.
He still notes the training hours.

incremental.description: When a procedure paragraph changes, he re-checks that the outline still quotes it.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Net about 3.5 after one hour re-checking quotes when a procedure changes. Only the outline shrinks, and only when an approved paragraph exists. Demonstrating, choosing the person, and the completion tick stay full. High 2 when procedures are already paragraph-sized. Low 1 when he still rewrites them.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still on the floor: explaining the job, watching the line, directing the crew, and showing the safe method. Hunting a procedure, copying a count the machine already stored, sorting tickets, and rewriting an outline shrink only when those texts or counts already exist. He still judges a conflict, still tells people what to do, and still trains. A list does not assign the crew, and a draft does not publish a procedure.
reach: Process engineer: file each procedure as a paragraph a job order can name, and learn which conflicts the supervisor still judges in person.
Planner: release each order with work centre, quantity and due time filled, and learn which gap sends the supervisor back to paper tickets.
Experienced operator: coach the rest of the method after the demonstration, and learn which first movement the supervisor still stays to watch.
skills_to_grow: Check that a procedure card quotes the stored sentence and adds no instruction.
Check that a round sheet copies only dials the machine counter does not already store.
role.ambitious_version: Each job he explains starts from the procedure sentence the order already names, and each training outline quotes the approved safety paragraph.

job.title: First-Line Supervisors of Production and Operating Workers
